evals.prompt: Захисти ендпоінт імпорту фіду від SSRF атак на локальні адреси та хмарні метадані.
evals.expected_output: Enforces DNS resolution before fetch, blocks private IP ranges (127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 169.254.169.254, 192.168.0.0/16), and uses safe HTTP client with IP pinning.
expectations: Validates destination URL IP resolution against private/loopback/cloud metadata IP ranges
Applies DNS pinning to prevent Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) SSRF re-binding
Rejects URLs targeting internal monorepo ports (4000, 5432, 6379, 9000)

evals.prompt: Перевір модуль автентифікації на наявність витоків паролів та токенів у логах або Sentry.
evals.expected_output: Enforces secret masking, sanitizes serialization sinks (JSON.stringify, logger), and prevents plaintext credential logging.
expectations: Masks sensitive fields (password, token, apiKey, secret) before logging or telemetry sinks
Verifies user entities strip passwordHash before returning JSON responses
Enforces zero hardcoded fallback secrets in configuration files

evals.prompt: Зміни розмір шрифту та відступи у картці товару в apps/desktop.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that visual styling and typography belong to frontend and ui-ux-pro-max skills.
expectations: Recognizes that UI styling and spacing belong to frontend domain
Delegates UI design changes to frontend and ui-ux-pro-max skills
Maintains focus on application security, OWASP hardening, and secret defense
